The longest river in the world is the Nile River.

To help you understand the concept of herd immunity provided in the text, here is an analogy:

Imagine a neighborhood where a contagious flu is spreading. If almost everyone in the neighborhood has gotten the flu shot (is protected), the virus has very few people to jump to. Even if one person gets sick, the chain of transmission is broken because the virus hits a "wall" of vaccinated neighbors. This protects the few people who couldn't get the shot (like those with severe allergies) because the virus can't reach them. This is similar to how a computer firewall blocks malicious code from spreading through a network if most computers are secured.
